- PRIMARY METRIC: Boeing's primary customer segments as of FY2022 include Commercial Airplanes, Defense, Space & Security, and Global Services. The revenue contributions from these segments are as follows:
  - Commercial Airplanes: $27,100 million (per the FY2022 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
  - Defense, Space & Security: $26,300 million (per the FY2022 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
  - Global Services: $16,300 million (per the FY2022 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)

- SUPPORTING DATA:
  - FY2021 Revenue Contributions:
    - Commercial Airplanes: $12,426 million (per the FY2021 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
    - Defense, Space & Security: $22,100 million (per the FY2021 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
    - Global Services: $18,525 million (per the FY2021 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
  - FY2020 Revenue Contributions:
    - Commercial Airplanes: $39,000 million (per the FY2020 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
    - Defense, Space & Security: $26,400 million (per the FY2020 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
    - Global Services: $19,162 million (per the FY2020 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)

- DATA SOURCES: 
  - FY2022 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations
  - FY2021 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations
  - FY2020 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations

Note: This report strictly contains factual data as requested. Further analysis or interpretation is not included.
